header.name: PracticeCrystalSimBot BP
header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.5.6: hardened against current-engine quirk where a SimulatedPlayer surfaces as undefined in world.getAllPlayers() and playerSpawn events (all player lookups/loops now skip falsy entries; bot-online no longer breaks player iteration). v0.5.5: crystal-surf spawns ender_crystal (entity id, not the item id) and async failures can no longer freeze movement. v0.5.4: hard preset keeps 0-value cooldowns; hole-escape ladder works; blast-mitigation block spam tamed. v0.5.3: un-namespaced "bot" registration removed (/bot via pvpbot:bot alias). v0.5.2: /bot caller resolved from CustomCommandOrigin.sourceEntity.
